words.clue: A white or grey shape made of tiny water drops in the sky
A living thing that often grows in soil
A hard outer covering found on some sea animals
A vehicle that travels on railway tracks
A word meaning ready to face something difficult

stories.label: A CLEVER PLAN
stories.title: Pip Saves a Nut
stories.text: Pip the squirrel found a large nut before the rainy season. He tucked it into a small hole near a tree and covered it with leaves. Later, when the rain began, Pip remembered where he had hidden his food.
stories.question: Why did Pip hide the nut?

stories.label: A TINY JOURNEY
stories.title: The Busy Bee
stories.text: A bee visited a yellow flower to collect nectar. Pollen stuck to its fuzzy body. When the bee visited another flower, some pollen rubbed off and helped the plant make seeds.
stories.question: How can the bee help a plant?

stories.label: A KIND CHOICE
stories.title: The Hot Afternoon
stories.text: Arun rode his bicycle to the park on a warm afternoon. He brought a bottle of water and stopped in the shade when he felt hot. After resting, he felt ready to ride home safely.
stories.question: What did Arun do when he felt hot?

stories.label: LOOK AFTER NATURE
stories.title: The Clean Beach
stories.text: Maya noticed a plastic wrapper near a tide pool. With an adult's help, she placed it in a rubbish bin. She knew that keeping litter out of the sea helps protect marine animals.
stories.question: Why did Maya put the wrapper in the bin?
options: To help keep the sea clean

stages.title: Sunlight reaches a puddle
stages.description: The Sun warms water on the ground.
stages.question: What can happen to some of the warmed water?

stages.title: Water vapour rises
stages.description: Water vapour moves up into cooler air.
stages.question: What may happen when water vapour cools?

stages.title: Clouds form
stages.description: Tiny water droplets gather to form clouds.
stages.question: What may happen when droplets join and grow heavy?

stages.title: Water returns to Earth
stages.description: Rain replenishes rivers, lakes and the ground.
stages.question: What can the Sun do to water again?
options: Warm it so the cycle can continue

weeklyMission.title: Design a Weather Helper
weeklyMission.description: Draw a tiny weather station with a rain gauge, a wind sock and a place to record sunny or cloudy days.
steps: Explain which tool helps you most
